summary: Arch Capital Group Ltd. filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing a $3.0 billion increase to its existing share repurchase authorization, leaving approximately $3.6 billion available after recent buybacks. Repurchases may occur in open market or privately negotiated transactions, subject to market, corporate, and regulatory factors, with no stated price, premium, or expiry. Separately, the Board declared Series F and Series G preferred dividends payable December 31, 2026 to holders of record December 15, 2026. Watch pacing of buybacks against book value and preferred dividend coverage.
